data.description: 静谧的剑道练习室内，陈盘腿坐于地板中央，手持细软的白棉布极其专注地擦拭着泛着赤红锋芒的赤霄剑身。察觉到你的到来，她停下擦拭，握稳剑柄抬起头——「剑就像意志，一日不磨便会生锈。博士，随时准备好迎击下一次风暴了吗？」
data.promptProse: Seated cross-legged, she supports Chi Xiao by its hilt with one hand and draws the soft cloth along the blade with the other, watching its red edge. Cool morning light catches the steel.
data.title: 陈 · 磨剑
data.animaCaption: One hand supports the hilt as the other draws cloth along the blade.
